name: SEO Bulk Admin
author: ampwptools

sections.description:
SEO Bulk Admin: Revolutionize Your WordPress Management

SEO Bulk Admin is your ultimate solution for effortlessly managing WordPress posts, pages, and WooCommerce products. This powerful plugin simplifies your workflow by allowing you to bulk assign categories and tags, move posts from one category to another, bulk delete posts, and efficiently redirect pages and posts to categories or specific URLs with various redirect directives. Say goodbye to tedious, manual updates and welcome a new era of streamlined content management.

Managing WordPress content shouldn’t be a hassle. SEO Bulk Admin simplifies the way you handle posts, pages, and WooCommerce products—allowing you to bulk edit, move, delete, optimize, and organize content with ease.

Key Features

AI & Search Bot Crawl Monitoring
*Track search engine crawlers and AI bot visits to your site, providing insights into which pages are most frequently crawled and considered important.

Page View Tracking
*Record visitor page views, including user IP addresses, bot activity, and referral sources, to better understand your traffic and optimize for growth.

Bulk Editor
*Effortless Editing: Quickly edit categories and tags.
*Find/Replace: Update content and URLs and from a single, intuitive interface.

Bulk Deleting
*Flexible Deletion Options: Delete posts, pages, and products in bulk using various filter combinations.
*Targeted Deletions: Remove posts by category, URL, title, or content, giving you complete control over your content cleanup.

Bulk Move
*Category Management: Move posts from one category to another or disassociate posts from a specific category.
*Tag Management: Transfer posts between tags or seamlessly disassociate posts from specific tags, ensuring your content is always accurately categorized.

Tag Optimization (Pro Feature)
*Optimize your SEO and social tags across posts via the SEO Bulk Admin panel. View by keyword, popularity, or publish date to easily see how many posts you have on a topic. Optimize directly in the panel to improve your site performance.

Redirect Manager (Pro Feature)
*Create and Manage Redirects: Easily set up and manage redirects without requiring Apache or Nginx knowledge. If your WordPress site supports permalinks, you can use this feature to redirect any URL. Choose from 301, 302, 307, or 308 redirect directives to suit your specific needs.

Why Choose SEO Bulk Admin?

SEO Bulk Admin is designed for efficiency and ease of use. Whether you’re managing a small blog or a large e-commerce site, this plugin provides robust tools to help you keep your content organized and optimized. With its user-friendly interface and comprehensive feature set, SEO Bulk Admin ensures that your WordPress management tasks are faster and more efficient.

Get Started with SEO Bulk Admin

Transform how you manage your WordPress site with SEO Bulk Admin. Simplify your workflow, enhance your SEO, and keep your content perfectly organized with this powerful plugin. Download SEO Bulk Admin today and experience the future of WordPress management.

Additional Features

Bulk Create Tags: Streamline the process of adding tags to multiple posts at once.
Disassociate Posts: Easily remove posts from specific categories or tags without hassle.
Admin Interface: Manage all your redirects and bulk actions from a single, centralized admin interface.

Perfect for:
Bloggers
E-commerce site owners
Content managers
SEO specialists

sections.installation:
1. In your admin panel, go to Plugins and click the ‘Add New’ button.
  2. Click Upload Plugin then Browse for the .zip file on your computer.
  3. Click Install Now
  4. Click on the ‘Activate’ button.
sections.faq:
How do I bulk assign categories and tags to multiple posts?

With SEO Bulk Admin, you can easily bulk assign categories and tags directly from the Bulk Editor. Simply select the posts you want to update, choose the desired categories or tags, and save your changes. The updates will be applied instantly.

Can I use SEO Bulk Admin with other SEO plugins like Yoast or Rank Math?

Yes, you can still use Yoast or Rank Math for SEO content creation without any conflicts.

Can I move posts from one category to another without affecting my SEO?

Yes, SEO Bulk Admin allows you to move posts from one category to another seamlessly. You can also set up redirects to ensure that your SEO is not negatively impacted. Choose from 301, 302, 307, or 308 redirect directives to suit your specific needs.

Is it possible to bulk delete posts based on specific criteria?

Absolutely! SEO Bulk Admin provides flexible options for bulk deleting posts. You can delete posts by category, tag, URL, title, or content. Use the various filters to target and remove exactly what you need, streamlining your content management process.

How do I manage redirects using SEO Bulk Admin?

Managing redirects is simple with SEO Bulk Admin. The plugin allows you to create and manage redirects without needing any technical knowledge of Apache or Nginx. If your WordPress site supports permalinks, you can redirect any URL effortlessly. All your redirects can be managed from a centralized admin interface.
sections.changelog:
1.2.2 – 2025-08-29

  • Revision – Renamed Block List to Blacklist to indicate that it is not blocking anything.
  • Revision – Added CSV export for blacklisted IP addresses.
  • Fix – Implemented javascript to detect and hide empty charts and sidebar.
  • Fix – Minor fix in how it reports last view date in aria labels.

1.2.1 – 2025-08-19

  • New Feature – AI/Bots tab with charts and details on activity from AI bots and crawlers.
  • New Feature – Views Tab with charts and details on page, post, etc. views across your website.
  • New Feature – Block List tab with reports by IP and location that allow you to ignore views from any source.
  • New Feature – Feedback tab allowing you to give direct feedback, report issues, or make requests.

1.2.0 – 2025-06-25

  • Revision – Moved view tracking into a database for better analysis. All previous hit counts will be cleared.
  • New Feature – Home tab with reports for view tracking.
  • New Feature – Settings tab with an option to turn off view tracking.

1.1.3 – 2025-04-18

  • Fix – The batch processing javascript was failing when attempting to check for compatibility with Pro.
  • New Feature – Added category and tag support for pages and other custom post types.

1.1.2 – 2025-03-18

  • Feature Update – Find and replace HTML displays now highlight the search and replace values within the displayed HTML code.
  • Fix – Changed all WP option keys to use underscore, preventing them from showing up as Custom Meta values in the post editor.
  • Revision – Moved the admin_script.js and admin_style.css files to the script folder in the plugin.
  • Revision – Changed object classes and data attributes to support data editing features provided by SEO Bulk Admin Pro.
  • Revision – Added text field filtering for typed and pasted values withing the base and Pro plugin interfaces.

1.1.1 – 2024-11-15

  • Feature Update – Added the ability to reverse the find and replacement process if you find problems after running it.
  • Minor Fix – Replaced wp_update_post() used for find/replace with $wpdb->update to prevent the removal of backslashes from the post content.

1.1.0 – 2024-10-29

  • New Feature – Find and replace URLs across all pages and posts on your website.

= =
* First release
